selected.label: portable A contract
text: ### Portable A-card lesson contract

An A card delivers a standalone, browser-openable lesson bundle with a small interactive exercise: choose an action or condition, inspect a synthetic trace, and check the expected outcome. Use standard HTML/browser behavior so an approved application framework or Azure subscription is not needed to begin.

Each bundle declares source ID, objective, preconditions, actions, synthetic input/trace, expected assertions, and limits. It prominently says **Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result**, makes no management calls, contains no credentials, and supports keyboard operation.

Each lesson must add a worked, testable exercise rather than copying the backlog sentence. Keep it portable for later mounting by C041. The native implementation and evidence remain a separate B card, and the source demo is not complete until both required slices and its original acceptance gates pass.

selected.label: packet rule
text: Packet membership is fixed before admission. This register overrides default membership for its named cards; every other A/B card belongs to SC-Snnn, and every other capability card belongs to its first listed source parent. A card has one packet, not duplicate packet credits.

selected.label: one-unit workflow
text: Implementation order is BDD specification, genuine behavioral TDD red, the IaC step (or an explicit N/A for a resource-free lesson), implementation/refactoring, green tests and actual browser checks, scoped tagged publication, and parent-owned empirical acceptance. A worker cannot award its own Done credit. Subdivision preserves the original `kanoUnit`; partial work does not manufacture extra value.

selected.label: parent completion
text: - Every one of the 150 D-S parents has exactly two required children: A-Snnn and B-Snnn.
